test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 28 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Refer to the following number series and answer the question that follows.

(left) 3 7 9 2 1 5 3 9 2 6 5 8 7 9 1 3 5 9 4 6 (right)

Which is the eighth digit to the left of the twelfth digit from the left end of the series?
solution:
Given series: 3 7 9 2 1 5 3 9 2 6 5 8 7 9 1 3 5 9 4 6 

The twelfth digit from the left end is: 8

and the eighth digit to the left of 8 is: 2

So, the eighth digit to the left of the twelfth digit from the left end of the series will be **'2'**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
